name: Kuraki Hideomi
source:
A student of Ryuuga's class he's smelly, overweight, and unhygienic, often covered in paint from painting his prized figures. The girls in Ryuuga's class hate him and make fun of him especially because he's an otaku. He gets along with nobody.

When Ryuuga takes over the school however he becomes one of his most loyal followers for the promise of raping the girls. He especially likes Yayoi and Ryuuga's girlfriend Natsuki.
